# Build ROOT with Clang and libc++ instead of GNU libstdc++ on Linux.
# The Fedora 44 image provides clang and libcxx/libcxxabi-devel packages.
CMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang
CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=clang++
CMAKE_GENERATOR=Ninja
CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD=20
soversion=ON
libcxx=ON
davix=OFF
tpython=OFF
minuit2_omp=OFF
# All C++ dependencies must be built with the same toolchain: the ones
# shipped by the distribution are compiled with libstdc++ and are ABI
# incompatible with a libc++ ROOT build.
builtin_civetweb=ON
builtin_fftw3=ON
builtin_freetype=ON
builtin_ftgl=ON
builtin_gif=ON
builtin_gl2ps=ON
builtin_gtest=ON
builtin_gsl=ON
builtin_jpeg=ON
builtin_lz4=ON
builtin_lzma=ON
builtin_nlohmann=ON
builtin_pcre=ON
builtin_png=ON
builtin_tbb=ON
builtin_tiff=ON
builtin_unuran=ON
builtin_vdt=ON
builtin_xrootd=ON
builtin_xxhash=ON
builtin_zlib=ON
builtin_zstd=ON
test_distrdf_dask=OFF
test_distrdf_pyspark=OFF
